Agency MVG / SWM (Münchner Verkehrsgesellschaft mbH, Stadtwerke München). Do not invent city=germany, city=bavaria, city=mvv, or merge into an S-Bahn city.

City stays planned until Jim wires testers. Modes v1: TRAIN-like = MVG U-Bahn U1–U8 only. No S-Bahn, no DB / RE / RB, no tram (including Tram 14), no bus / ExpressBus / Nachtlinien, no U9, no U5-to-Pasing, no U6-to-Martinsried.
Timezone Europe/Berlin HAS DST (CEST/CET). Do not copy no-DST cities.
